title: Telaris Pluriverse galaxy envelope payload, v1.0
description: The decoded JWS payload of a published galaxy envelope (typ application/vnd.telaris.pluriverse-envelope.v1+json). Receivers MAY validate against this schema before verifying the signature. Settled fields are closed; the node and media shapes stay open while content-addressed media (5c-media) is finalized.

protocol_version.description: Envelope protocol version. Mismatch is rejected before any other check.

origin_host.description: Hostname of the authoring instance; the JWS kid is anchored to it.

slug.description: Immutable federation identifier for the galaxy. Lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens.

published_sequence.description: Strict-monotonic publish counter for this slug. A receiver rejects any value not strictly greater than the last it accepted.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 publish timestamp. Bounded to a 30-day sanity window relative to receipt.

nonce.description: Per-envelope base64url nonce for the per-origin replay store.

node.description: A wormhole. Open to additional fields while the federated node shape evolves.

target_slug.description: Present only on portal nodes: the destination galaxy slug.

media_ref.description: A media reference on a node. Local-upload media is content-addressed: { field, sha256, mime }, fetched from GET /media/{sha256} and re-hashed. Media that is an external URL keeps { field, src }. Exactly one of sha256 or src is present.
